
name: Build Android APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Unpack game
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p game build
          unzip -q -o GoblinRunner-Fixed-Android.zip -d game
          test -f game/project.godot
          test -f game/main.tscn
          test -f game/export_presets.cfg

      - name: Set up Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install Android SDK components
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=${ANDROID_HOME}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          yes | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --licenses >/dev/null || true
          "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" \
            'platform-tools' 'platforms;android-35' 'build-tools;35.0.0'

      - name: Install Godot 4.4.1 and export templates
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          base=https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.4.1-stable
          curl -fL --retry 3 -o /tmp/godot.zip "$base/Godot_v4.4.1-stable_linux.x86_64.zip"
          sudo unzip -q /tmp/godot.zip -d /usr/local/bin
          sudo mv /usr/local/bin/Godot_v4.4.1-stable_linux.x86_64 /usr/local/bin/godot
          sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/godot
          curl -fL --retry 3 -o /tmp/export_templates.tpz "$base/Godot_v4.4.1-stable_export_templates.tpz"
          mkdir -p /tmp/godot-templates "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.4.1.stable"
          unzip -q /tmp/export_templates.tpz 'templates/android_debug.apk' 'templates/android_release.apk' 'templates/version.txt' -d /tmp/godot-templates
          cp /tmp/godot-templates/templates/* "$HOME/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.4.1.stable/"
          godot --version

      - name: Configure Godot Android exporter and debug signing
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/godot" "$HOME/.android"
          cat > "$HOME/.config/godot/editor_settings-4.tres" <<SETTINGS
          [gd_resource type="EditorSettings" format=3]

          [resource]
          export/android/android_sdk_path = "$ANDROID_HOME"
          export/android/java_sdk_path = "$JAVA_HOME"
          SETTINGS
          keytool -genkeypair -v \
            -keystore "$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" \
            -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android -keypass android \
            -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 \
            -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US"
          echo "GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_DEBUG_PATH=$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo 'GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_DEBUG_USER=androiddebugkey' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo 'GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_DEBUG_PASSWORD=android' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Import assets
        run: godot --headless --path game --editor --import --quit

      - name: Export Android APK
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          godot --headless --path game --export-debug Android "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build/GoblinRunner-debug.apk"
          test -s build/GoblinRunner-debug.apk

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: GoblinRunner-Android
          path: build/GoblinRunner-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
